text:
Mei (CS): quick heads up — Orchid is asking to reduce seats from 120 -> 95 and shorten renewal from 12mo to 10mo. They're requesting a credit for the 25 unused seats and procurement says a PO is required before any invoice. Draft amendment ready for legal review. any blockers?
Javier (AE): no blockers on AE side. customer explained seat drop due to reorg, agreed to prorated pricing. they want split billing (2 invoices) to align with their internal quarters.
Nia (Finance): split invoices fine but billing needs vendor code to accept PO. if VC isn't issued today we can allow a one-time CC charge for invoice 1 with conditions. add remittance email on PO.
Mei (CS): noted. i'll include a prorate/credit table in the amendment and a clause describing how the credit applies to next invoice. sending to legal and then to customer for signature.
Lucas (Legal): we can do credit application language but prefer issuing a credit memo rather than automatic set-off; will keep data processing and indemnities unchanged. i'll post a redline shortly.
Procurement Partner (Orchid): raised vendor code request (ticket #99-ORC) with central ops. PO will be generated once VC is returned. our billing contact is payments@orchid.com.
Support Bot: Created tracking ticket CS-5224 for the onboarding and seat-change actions -> https://tickets.internal/CS-5224
Javier (AE): customer asked if enablement can start earlier. they'd accept a sandbox/admin pre-kick if legal permits limited access before signature.
Lucas (Legal): partial access OK for sandbox/admin only. no production credentials until signed. i'll add that to the amendment.
Mei (CS): @Nia for CC fallback: how long can we allow the CC invoice before they must produce PO?
Nia (Finance): CC fallback approved for invoice 1 only. PO copy must be submitted within 10 calendar days of invoice date or billing will pause further invoices. billing lead must sign off (cc'ed).
Mei (CS): sending amendment to DocuSign now so we don't delay once VC is ready.
Docusign Bot: Envelope sent -> envelope_id: env_a1b2c | to: jessica@orchid.com | status: sent | link: https://docusign.example/env/env_a1b2c | ts: 4765432140
Procurement Partner (Orchid): vendor code assigned: VC-ORC-77. PO-001234 will be uploaded to your billing portal within 3 hours.
Docusign Bot: Envelope update -> envelope_id: env_a1b2c | status: completed | signer: jessica@orchid.com | ts: 4765432210
Mei (CS): amendment signed, great. @Nia please proceed: invoice 1 = prorated amount to charge on CC, invoice 2 = remaining balance net30 after PO conversion. @Javier confirm customer ok with that flow.
Javier (AE): confirmed with customer. they'll send scanned PO to billing and confirm net30 for invoice 2.
Mei (CS): action items: 1) Billing: run CC charge for invoice1 and watch for PO upload; 2) Legal: finalize redline and store signed amendment; 3) Support: update onboarding timeline to start sandbox pre-kick and shift production kickoff pending PO; 4) CS: close when PO matched. i'll follow up EOD. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
